Locke’s Two Treatises of Government presented a critique of the divine right of kings and outlined the principles of natural rights and govern- ment by consent. Written during the 1670s, they were not published until after the Glorious Revolution of 1688 and the passage of the English Bill of Rights in 1689. Locke was the political theorist quoted most frequently by Americans in the 1770s. 1690 Chapter II. Of the state of nature.
